description: This file contains backend API implementations for the COSA Data Model related to Hosts management, including functions to get/set parameters, handle object entries, and manage host information and their associated IPv4 addresses. It also manages synchronization, validation, and updates of host properties, with locking mechanisms for thread safety.

classes.name: PLmObjectHost
classes.description: Represents a host object with properties like address, activity time, and associated IP addresses.

classes.name: PLmObjectHostIPAddress
classes.description: Represents an IPv4 address associated with a host.

classes.name: PLmObjectHostIPAddress
classes.description: Represents an IPv4 or IPv6 address associated with a host.

methods.name: BOOL Hosts_GetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL * pBool)
methods.description: Retrieves boolean parameters such as notification and presence detection enable flags.

methods.name: BOOL Hosts_SetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL bValue)
methods.description: Sets boolean parameters related to presence notification and detection.

methods.name: BOOL Hosts_GetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int * pInt)
methods.description: Retrieves integer parameters, currently not implemented.

methods.name: BOOL Hosts_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * puLong)
methods.description: Retrieves ulong parameters like IPv4/IPv6 check intervals and retries, host version ID, count period.

methods.name: ULONG Hosts_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters such as host sync source, MAC addresses, and Eth Host sync info.

methods.name: BOOL Hosts_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pString)
methods.description: Sets string parameters such as presence notification MACs, host sync info, and comments.
